name: constup-foss/php-attributes
description: A collection of PHP attributes and their processors.

scripts-descriptions.csfix: Fix all project's files with PHP CS Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.csfix-unix-ignore-env: Fix all project's files with PHP CS Fixer on Unix systems. Ignore environment (PHP version) requirements of PHP CS Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.csfix-windows-ignore-env: Fix all project's files with PHP CS Fixer on Windows systems. Ignore environment (PHP version) requirements of PHP CS Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit: Run PHP Unit on the whole project. PHP Unit must be installed as Composer dependency.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit-coverage: Run PHP Unit on the whole project and generate a code coverage report. PHP Unit must be installed as Composer dependency.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit-migrate-configuration: Migrate PHPUnit configuration to the new format. PHP Unit must be installed as Composer dependency.
